name: Find Myranda
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
adventurer, you have done all that I have asked thus far. Only one step remains in your quest of redemption.

You must deliver the items you have collected to Taelan. Unfortunately, Taelan and his Scarlet Crusaders will attack you on sight.

There is only one way in which to deliver my message and that is through a guise of deception.

To the south you will find Uther's tomb. An old and trusted confidant of mine, Myranda, now resides there - seek her out. Show her the items and she will assist you.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I was Tirion's most trusted advisor when he held rank as Lord of Mardenholde. I openly dissented the verdict passed by the Order of the Silver Hand and was banished for my insolence.

He has been through much heart ache and disappointment in his life, friend. Are you prepared to right the wrongs set upon the Fordrings?
narrative.requestItemsText: I knew this day would come.

chain.subtitle: 11 quests from level 56 to 60, 64,475 XP in all.

quests.name: Demon Dogs
quests.objectiveText: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds.

quests.name: Blood Tinged Skies
quests.objectiveText: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

quests.name: Carrion Grubbage
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region.

quests.name: Redemption
quests.objectiveText: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

quests.name: Of Forgotten Memories
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer.

quests.name: Of Lost Honor
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.objectiveText: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands.

quests.name: Find Myranda
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Scarlet Subterfuge
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Myranda to gain the Scarlet Illusion.

quests.name: In Dreams
quests.objectiveText: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
